sources.lesson: Range fills lack queue/spread; stop before ROI; current contract limits are not historical limits. Pinned installed engine source controls this experiment.
Native unfilledtimeout can precede custom callback. custom_exit never substitutes for hard stop.
Generic slicing only checks observed signals; cached replay schedules require independent raw-prefix/shortlist tests.
Repeated selection creates false discoveries; use one target hypothesis and sealed chronological evaluation. No numerical PBO estimate is warranted by this sample.
Motivates execution stress, not measured strategy advantage.
UM archive milliseconds, taker-buy fields are limited candle imbalance, not full order flow.
